Biography

Dr. Lin studies the structure, interactions, and dynamics of molecules. His research combines rotational spectroscopy with computational methods to investigate hydrogen bonding and molecular motion.

Research Interests

  • Pure rotational and vibration-rotation-tunneling spectra of hydrogen-bonded and van der Waals complexes.
  • Microwave dielectric spectroscopy of liquids and solids.
  • High level ab initio and density functional theory (DFT) calculations.

Education

  • Postdoctoral, Physical Chemistry University of California Berkeley, 06/2005-08/2007
  • Ph.D., Chemical Physics Wesleyan University, 2005
  • M.S., Physical Chemistry University of British Columbia, 1999
  • B.S., Chemistry Xiamen University, 1995
